# App tutorials and creative exercises

> Browse English tutorials for Aquarell, ManYue, VectorPaint, Book Isle, iCouldPlay and Yearn by app, learning path or keyword.

## Reading context

These are guides and product information from Bison, the developer of the six apps; they are not independent reviews or rankings.
Markdown is another representation of the same HTML content. Read feature limits, source attributions and version notes in the linked page. English pages are translations of the Chinese originals.

## App learning paths

- [Aquarell Tutorials: Drawing, Layers and Export](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/aquarell/llms.txt): Start with a canvas, brushes and layers. Practise leaves, flowers, still life and landscapes, then learn PNG, JPEG, PSD and native-project saving.
- [ManYue Tutorials: Comics, NAS and Reading Sync](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/manyue/llms.txt): Import local comics and prepare offline reading, then organise shelves, adjust reading settings and connect NAS libraries, servers and sync.
- [VectorPaint Tutorials: Icons, SVG and Export](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint/llms.txt): Learn shapes, fills and strokes, then edit paths and nodes, organise layers, add gradients and text, and choose SVG, PNG or PDF for delivery.
- [Book Isle Tutorials: EPUB, NAS and Calibre](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/nasbook/llms.txt): Begin with local ebooks, reading layout and notes, then connect WebDAV, SMB, OPDS or Calibre and check reading-data sync.
- [iCouldPlay Tutorials: Video, NAS and Subtitles](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/icouldplay/llms.txt): Start with a local video, connect NAS folders and media servers, organise films and series, then check subtitles, audio tracks and playback compatibility.
- [Yearn Tutorials: Game Import, Controllers and Saves](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/yearn/llms.txt): Prepare your own games and platform files, then check touch or physical controls, saves, offline play, display layouts and launch issues.
